title: ZOPS 连接配置
description: 填写你的 ZOPS 面板地址与访问令牌。令牌在面板的「MCP」页创建，只在创建时显示一次，服务端只存 SHA-256；这里填的内容仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
description_en: Enter the address of your ZOPS panel and an access token. Create the token on the panel's "MCP" page — it is shown only once and the server stores just its SHA-256. What you enter here stays on this machine under ~/.workbuddy.
docLabel: 怎么拿令牌？打开面板 → 「MCP」页 → 新建令牌
docLabel_en: How do I get a token? Open the panel → "MCP" page → create one

fields.label: 协议
fields.description: 面板的访问协议。用 IP:端口 直连填 http；面板前面挂了 Caddy 并配了域名、走 HTTPS 时填 https。
fields.description_en: Panel access schema. Use http when connecting directly by IP:port; use https when a Caddy in front terminates TLS for a domain.

fields.label: 面板地址
fields.description: ZOPS 面板所在机器的主机名或 IP。面板装在服务器上、agent 跑在你本地时，这里填服务器的可达地址（内网 IP 或域名）。
fields.description_en: Hostname or IP of the machine running the ZOPS panel. When the panel is on a server and the agent runs locally, this must be an address reachable from here (a LAN IP or a domain).

fields.label: 端口
fields.description: 面板监听端口。官方安装脚本默认 5200，安装时选「随机」或自定义的请照面板「MCP」页给出的地址填。
fields.description_en: Panel listening port. The official installer defaults to 5200; if you picked a random or custom port, copy it from the address shown on the panel's "MCP" page.

fields.label: 访问令牌
fields.description: 以 ops_ 开头的面板令牌。只读令牌只能查状态；要重启容器、重载网关、改 Caddyfile，需要在面板上建一个读写令牌。
fields.description_en: A panel token starting with ops_. A read-only token can inspect state; restarting containers, reloading the gateway or editing the Caddyfile requires a read-write token.
